_schema.description: Live trade ledger for the Kippa signal track record. Every position taken off the Discord signal is recorded here so performance is measured, not remembered (Project Vision: every output has supporting evidence; historical information is preserved). The PnL engine (src/engines/pnl/engine.py) marks open trades to the platform's WTI feed and computes the running record. This file is NOT secret — it is committed. It holds no account numbers or credentials.

fields.contracts: number of CL contracts (1 contract = 1000 bbl); null if tracking in $/bbl and % only
fields.exit_price: $/bbl fill on close; null while open

_schema.accounts_note: The 'accounts' array tracks equity per trader (deposit vs current balance). These are self-reported paper balances — leveraged futures returns, so account % far exceeds the underlying WTI move. Recorded as given; correct anytime.
_schema.testing_plan: Paper-trade the signal through 2026-08-31, then commit real capital if the record holds.
